name: Party Identification 318
definition: Provides information about identification of the party.

ProcessingIdentification.name: Processing Identification
ProcessingIdentification.definition: Reference meaningful to the party identified.

AlternateIdentification.name: Alternate Identification
AlternateIdentification.definition: Provides alternate identification for a party using an id type, a country code and a text field.

AdditionalInforrmationRule.definition: The AdditionalInformation field in all elements must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed or advised differently in the element definition as in NarrativeVersion.
